title: Aerospace DAO — Launch Complex 39A
summary: An agent-managed DAO cell on the pad where Apollo and Crew Dragon flew: five zones across the marsh-lined launch complex, from Charter Hall at the Fixed Service Structure to a Progress Observatory beside the lagoon, with agents drafting and people deciding.

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model and measurable outcomes

buildings.name: Proposal Chamber
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and voted by people

court.name: Pad 39A Assembly Court
court.style: Blast-wall amphitheater on the former crawlerway apron
court.why_here: Between the Fixed Service Structure and the lagoon, this flat concrete apron is where Apollo and Crew Dragon hardware gathered before flight — a natural stage for people to assemble, debate and vote.

quests.title: Post the Charter
steps: Collect the charter text from the Proposal Chamber drafting gallery
Cross the crawlerway apron to the Charter Pavilion
Mount the charter plinth and verify the measurable-outcomes board reads back correctly

quests.title: Trace the Evidence
steps: Accept the week's evidence packet from the Evidence Monitor in the Synthesis Hangar
Summarize three findings at the annotation terminals
Deliver the summary to the Progress Tracker atop the Observatory Tower
Confirm the progress dials update against charter outcomes

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Read the task-routing board in the Coordination Deck
Deliver three routed tasks along the hangar row to the Synthesis Hangar
Report back at the Scout Outpost with the Collaborator Scout's confirmation

quests.title: The Human Vote
steps: Review the agent-drafted proposal on the Charter Pavilion outcome board
Walk to the Proposal Chamber and hear debate on the floor
Cast a ballot in the human-only voting booths
Watch the quorum bell confirm enactment by people, not agents

quests.title: Lagoon Census
steps: Count wading birds and record tide readings from the lagoon viewing deck
Log findings in the milestone bay
Carry the log to the Task Router for a new working-group task
Close the loop at the Coordination Deck board
